questions.question: Check the Academy’s historical names in 1919–1927 and the chronology of the Physics and Mathematics Institute’s name and affiliation; verify the faculty of which Steklov became dean in 1904.

localizations.source: Check the Academy’s historical names in 1919–1927 and the chronology of the Physics and Mathematics Institute’s name and affiliation; verify the faculty of which Steklov became dean in 1904.
localizations.ru: Сверить исторические названия Академии наук в 1919–1927 годах и хронологию названия и подчинения Физико-математического института; уточнить название факультета, деканом которого Стеклов стал в 1904 году.

questions.resolution: The Steklov Institute biography confirms that the Russian Academy became the USSR Academy in 1925, that the institute joined it in 1925 and received Steklov’s name in 1926; it also confirms the mathematics faculty in 1904.

questions.resolution: The text no longer generalizes the pupils’ academy status. Closure theory is used for Steklov’s théorie de fermeture, as catalogued by Math-Net.Ru.
